answer: No target string or exit code is fixed and Validation only runs pytest, so the executor must run each command and pin a real line/code (e.g. runtime status prints 'No Herdr Space found for <id>' and returns 0, runtime.py:42-43). Fix: name line+exit code per subcommand.

add hook: every flag is optional (parser.py:749-757). add faq-doc is generated from FAQDoc (parser.py:784-826); FAQDoc requires title+body (deskops/models/faq.py:19-22), title is exempt from required (parser.py:812), so --body is the only required flag.

desk install scaffolds desk/atoms/ but writes only tag-namespaces.yaml, no atom docs (workspace.py:168-239): atoms list prints nothing and atoms show needs an id. Fix: state the fixture seeds an atom first (add atom --title/--five-wh-one-plus/--answer).

No global --root; every command defines its own, so --root must follow the subcommand (parser.py:750 hook, 797 faq-doc, 138 atoms list, 154 atoms show, 68/73/76/89 runtime). A leading --root fails as an unrecognized argument.

main(argv) returns int (main.py:371-373); CLI.run catches argparse SystemExit and returns the code (main.py:58-61). main only re-raises SystemExit for unexpected exceptions (main.py:392), so assert the return value, not pytest.raises(SystemExit).

Resolved Decisions makes subprocess `_cli` the default, reserving in-process main+capsys for the command under test; but Implementation Path step 1's fixture install is unspecified. Fix: state the fixture install uses `_cli` (per test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py) and only the tested command calls main().

Target: monkeypatch.setattr('deskops.cli.commands.runtime.HerdrClient', Fake) (test_cli.py:2663). status/attach/stop/supervise/workers use it (runtime.py:35,73); init instead calls ensure_herdr_server+initialize_desk (runtime.py:24), so patch those too. test_herdr_runtime.py stubs via HerdrClient(runner=...), unreachable from main.

With the Herdr stub both succeed: status prints 'No Herdr Space found for <identity>' and returns 0 (runtime.py:42-43); init returns 0 once ensure_herdr_server/initialize_desk are stubbed (runtime.py:24-33). Without a stub init raises HerdrError (initializer.py:79-81).

Filename task-<slug>.md under desk/drawer/tasks/ (task-rw-f0-reject-ambiguous-selectors.md:1-22). Frontmatter: id, status: deferred, references: [], depends_on, pills, files, task_type, tags: workspace:desk/artifact:task/source:drawer, then the six standard sections.
Already stated in Scope: record each observed surprise as a new drawer task file, then mark that test xfail(strict=True, reason='<task id>'). No preemptive xfail; the reason is the new task's id.
Task already says 'parametrize where the shape repeats'; grouping is a style choice (e.g. the add family). No decision needed.

capsys captures both streams; runtime prints both success and error lines to stdout (runtime.py:58), and other commands print stable lines to stdout, so asserting a stdout line satisfies Done When. Subset of ambiguity 1.
Repo root, not desk root. parser help says 'DeskOps repository root' (parser.py:68) and RuntimeCLI resolves args.root then loads DeskConfig(root/'desk') (runtime.py:16,37).
